page.notes: Greek passages are printed in small italic-like type and are copied as closely as the scan allows; the Greek in the heading and the second paragraph is doubtful in several places. "fortes" in the first line may be "sortes"; the scan reads "fortes". The large initial "Ἀ" of the second paragraph is joined to "μέλει". The word "ἐμ-φοβ(ῶ)" at the line end is partly unreadable and is best checked against the scan. The printed hyphen at the end of "li-" stays.
